title: GlobalX策略师：中国科技被低估，IPO催化价值重估？
speaker: Billy Lung

segments.en: No matter you know doesn't matter that much right now so that's one thing we're looking much more for now in terms of expectations in terms of growth and what 2027 will look like but I think going back to your point about you know China being overlooked and being under price.
segments.zh: 目前这并不那么重要。我们更关注增长预期和2027年的前景。回到你提到的观点，中国资产被忽视且定价偏低。

segments.en: I think it's actually a matter of a function of the lack of capital markets a lot of capital market activity which is why I think I'm quite excited to see a you know the obviously the overnight news about clean raising money and having a valuation of that close to 15 to 18 billion US dollars.
segments.zh: 这实际上是资本市场活动不足的体现。因此，我很兴奋地看到昨晚的消息——某公司融资，估值接近150-180亿美元。

segments.en: We're also going to see potentially chip major chip companies in China listing as well and I think these are actually very strong catalyst for the market to actually go hey we haven't seen much realization of value.
segments.zh: 我们可能还会看到中国主要芯片公司上市。我认为这些是强有力的催化剂，让市场意识到价值尚未充分实现。

segments.en: We don't know where the benchmark or where the actual market was and now we're actually seeing more and more of these valuation being a benchmark and providing global investors to know hey there might be a potential under pricing in China.
segments.zh: 我们之前不知道基准在哪里，现在越来越多的估值成为基准，让全球投资者意识到中国可能存在定价偏低。

segments.en: And going back to your point this is exactly why global X in Australia launched the global X tech China tech ETF or ticker code DRGN or Dragon.
segments.zh: 回到你的观点，这正是Global X在澳大利亚推出中国科技ETF（代码DRGN）的原因。

segments.en: It's because we do believe that there is very strong value and very strong growth in this market going for not just in the next five years but potentially decades.
segments.zh: 因为我们相信这个市场有强劲的价值和增长，不仅未来五年，甚至可能持续数十年。

segments.en: What what could spark that tipping point then for people to tilt more back into this this this this realm right of China tech is it going to be earnings I mean what what do you think is going to be that catalyst.
segments.zh: 那么，什么能触发转折点，让人们重新关注中国科技领域？是盈利吗？你认为催化剂是什么？
